title.en: Haikei, Tengoku no Neesan, Yuusha ni Natta Mei ga Ero Sugite ーー Ojisan, Hogosha Toka Sorosoro Muri Desu+

altTitles.ja: 拝啓、天国の姉さん、勇者になった姪がエロすぎて──叔父さん、保護者とかそろそろ無理です＋(ぷらす)

altTitles.ja-ro: Haikei, Tengoku no Neesan, Yuusha ni Natta Mei ga Ero Sugite Ojisan, Hogosha Toka Sorosoro Muri Desu (Purasu)

altTitles.en: Dear Big Sister in Heaven, My Niece Who Became the Hero Is Too Erotic. Signed, Her Uncle. Being Something like Her Guardian Will Soon Be Impossible for Me+
My Niece Who Became Brave is Tooooo Erotic.

altTitles.vi: Đứa cháu gái của tôi đã thành hero, nhưng lại quá gợi cảm.

description.en:
Angel, a former top-tier mercenary, was forced to retire due to an injury. Left by his fiancée, he now spends his days drowning in alcohol—a middle-aged adventurer (and a virgin).
One day, his niece Liz, whom he once taught swordsmanship, suddenly barges into his life!
Angel is bewildered by how she has grown into an astonishingly beautiful girl, but Liz pays no heed to his hesitation and boldly declares that she will become his wife—?!
A heart-pounding fantasy adventure, in more ways than one, featuring a beautiful young heroine and her middle-aged uncle!
description.es-la: Un antiguo mercenario de los más fuertes, fue herido y se retiró, luego su prometida huyó y ahora pasa los días bebiendo como un aventurero de mediana edad (virgen). Entonces su sobrina Liz, a la que una vez enseñó esgrima, aparece para visitarle. Ahora angel está confundido por cómo se ha convertido en una chica impresionantemente bella, pero Liz ha declarado que se casará con él sin importarle sus sentimientos... ¡Una emocionante fantasía de aventuras en muchos sentidos, tejida por una bella heroína y un tío de mediana edad!
description.ja: 元・最強の傭兵だが負傷して引退…婚約者に逃げられた結果、現在は酒場で飲んだくれるだけの鬱屈とした日々を過ごす中年冒険者アンヘル（童貞）。そんな彼の下に、かつて剣術を教えた姪っ子リズが押しかけてきた！超絶美少女に成長を遂げた彼女は戸惑うアンヘルに「お嫁さんになってあげる」と宣言してきてーー!?
